# Reuse catalog

Utilities in `srv/lib`, shared types and aspects, text bundles. Rule: before writing a new function, look for it here and via `mcp__cds-mcp__search_model`.

## Functions in srv/lib

| File | Export | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | IMPORT_COLUMNS | Workbook columns in their documented spelling, mapped to the element written by the INSERT. |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | MANDATORY_COLUMNS | Columns a workbook must have; each missing one is its own structural error. |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | decodeContent | Decode the `content` of the action parameter into bytes. JSON clients send `Edm.Stream` |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | mapHeader | Map the header row to workbook columns. |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | coerceCell | Normalize one cell: trimmed text, empty text as undefined, numeric text as a number in the |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | toImportRows | Turn sheet data (header row first) into INSERT entries with their sheet row number. |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | readImportRows | Read the first sheet of an xlsx workbook and map it to import rows. |
| srv/lib/products-import.js | columnOf | Map an element name reported by the service's input validation back to the workbook column. |
